method: Require producer/root's explicit final SHA256 through --frozen; do not run merely because a file appears.
Bind film, master, recipe, clean-input receipt, producer receipt, full spec and reference probe JSON before and after every measurement.
Compare every AAC packet's size and payload hash and independently compare normalized ADTS bytes in memory.
Decode final audio and master at 48000Hz stereo float32 in memory; require identical bytes and 1495040 frames; report uncorrected container differences if any.
Strictly decode the whole film; independently meter encoded LUFS, true peak and LRA, then measure authored ending-fade energy.
Confirm 932 video frames at 30000/1001 and 1920x1080, inspect the 79-frame black tail, and record the approximately 49ms audio/video end gap.
Original reference AAC is never read or incorporated; final packet identity plus the earlier clean Digital Clouds placement receipt establish the mux input.
Keep technical audio PASS separate from SONIC_UNVERIFIED. No direct hearing or reference soundtrack identity claim.
scope: Only qa/audio-final-* files; read-only media verification; no provider calls, installs, production writes, film/audio edits or Git operations.
